from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

artifact = Path(sys.argv[1])
data = artifact.read_bytes()
assert len(data) <= 64 * 1024 * 1024 and data[:8] == b"\0asm\x01\0\0\0"

def uleb(pos):
    value = 0
    for shift in range(0, 35, 7):
        octet = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        value |= (octet & 127) << shift
        if octet < 128:
            return value, pos
    raise ValueError("invalid u32 LEB128")

names = dict(enumerate(("custom", "type", "import", "function", "table", "memory",
                        "global", "export", "start", "element", "code", "data",
                        "data_count", "tag")))
sections = []
cursor = 8
while cursor < len(data):
    section_start = cursor
    number = data[cursor]
    size, start = uleb(cursor + 1)
    cursor = start + size
    assert cursor <= len(data)
    section = {"type": names.get(number, str(number)), "payloadOffset": start,
               "payloadBytes": size, "headerBytes": start - section_start}
    if number == 0:
        length, name = uleb(start)
        assert name + length <= cursor
        section["name"] = data[name:name + length].decode()
    elif number in (3, 5, 7, 10, 11):
        count, pos = uleb(start)
        section["entries"] = count
        if number == 5:
            memory = []
            for _ in range(count):
                flags, pos = uleb(pos)
                assert flags in (0, 1)
                minimum, pos = uleb(pos)
                limits = {"minPages": minimum, "minBytes": minimum * 65536}
                if flags == 1:
                    limits["maxPages"], pos = uleb(pos)
                memory.append(limits)
            assert pos == cursor
            section["memory"] = memory
    sections.append(section)
assert 8 + sum(row["payloadBytes"] + row["headerBytes"] for row in sections) == len(data)
print(json.dumps({"bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), "sections": sections}, indent=2))

from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys

wasm = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
link_map = Path(sys.argv[2])
totals = {"CODE": Counter(), "DATA": Counter()}
region = None
icu = None
with link_map.open() as lines:
    for line in lines:
        columns = re.split(r"\s+", line.strip(), maxsplit=3)
        if len(columns) != 4:
            continue
        _, offset, size, text = columns
        if text in totals:
            region = text
            continue
        if region is None or ":(" not in text or not text.startswith(("/", "<internal>")):
            continue
        member = text.split(":(", 1)[0].rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        archive = member.split("(", 1)[0]
        totals[region][archive] += int(size, 16)
        if "icu_packaged_data.cpp.obj):(.rodata.icudt76_dat)" in text:
            assert icu is None
            start, length = int(offset, 16), int(size, 16)
            icu = {
                "archive": archive, "member": "icu_packaged_data.cpp.obj",
                "section": ".rodata.icudt76_dat", "wasmFileOffset": start,
                "bytes": length, "payloadSHA256": hashlib.sha256(wasm[start:start + length]).hexdigest()
            }
assert icu is not None
print(json.dumps({
    "icu": icu, "codeByArchive": totals["CODE"].most_common(),
    "dataByArchiveIncludingBSS": totals["DATA"].most_common(),
    "codeMapped": sum(totals["CODE"].values()),
}, indent=2))
